question: What named landing-penalty settings does SimEx_OnGround consume, and does the serialized route support a useful landing movement context for weapon/loadout comparison?

scope.notes: Exactly the two release assets named in the brief were traced. GRX_Glacier_Soldier has 272 captured objects; only objects 10, 75, and 126 corresponding to the three exact imported child GUIDs were inspected.

control.description: The M433 site pointer data/weapons.json:/[id=m433]/recoil/ads/amount is 0.6695. Release GS_HK433 raw f32 at 1084 matched 0.6695; the referenced pinned descriptor path is /Field_c5d1c8fe/Field_6b84de87/Field_22810b21 (RecoilAmount), and the source provenance names the exact registry association GS_HK433.Recoil.Zoomed.RecoilAmount.

rawChecks.label: Known-answer control: GS_HK433 ADS recoil amount

inference: The names support a candidate landing-penalty/recovery/minimum-scale-clamp setting family. That is a names-based inference, not a decoded formula.
The complete tuples are preserved by field hash. A conventional assignment of Field_42c8b257 to a current setting and Field_c06d0cbb/Field_3ff76ddb to bounds remains an unproven inference.
The raw numbers do not establish percentages, seconds, speed multipliers, or another player-facing unit.
The named input and resource-ref presence do not establish formula execution, runtime activation, or a relation to weapon/loadout mobility.
unresolved: Compiled resource ref cc04055a48e4ccad is an identity token only; the referenced expression body/operator sequence was not decoded.
Runtime activation and composition of the named input with soldier movement or a weapon/loadout are not established.
The semantic roles of Field_42c8b257, Field_c06d0cbb, and Field_3ff76ddb are not established by the pinned descriptor. Any current-value or bounds assignment remains inferred.
Units and player-facing meaning are unresolved; 9.0 is not established as 9 percent, and 0.5 is not established as half a second.
siteImpact: The Analyzer currently compares weapon-level ADS movement speed and sprint recovery. The L134 serialized route does not establish a formula, units, or activation that can turn these soldier setting tuples into a useful numerical loadout comparison. No landing-penalty panel or source context is proposed. No capture requested. Jump/landing numeric inventory is parked after L132 and L134 produced no supported correction or enhancement proposal.

orchestratorReview.scope: Exactly two assets and GRX children10/75/126; nine candidate float operands, within cap30.
orchestratorReview.classification: Source finding. Opaque tuple roles and an unexecuted expression do not support a useful numeric mobility panel.

leads.title: Jump-landing movement speed penalty
leads.summary: OnGround directly imports three named landing penalty, clamp and recovery GRX children; nine f32 slots are raw-verified, but roles, units and executed formula remain unresolved.
leads.reopenWhen: Reopen when a validated compiled-resource and activation trace establishes the formula, units, and semantic roles of the three f32 fields.

assets.question: What landing movement input and direct setting imports are serialized in the OnGround consumer?
assets.conclusion: Object 8 directly imports exactly the three specified GRX child GUIDs; object 0 names JumpLandingMovementSpeedPenalty and nested landing state variables, and object 8 contains resource-ref cc04055a48e4ccad. The expression and activation remain unresolved.

assets.question: What exact serialized settings are the three imported GRX children?
assets.conclusion: Only the three imported exported Class_d59e68b9 children were inspected; their names, GUIDs, and three-f32 field tuples matched raw bytes. Descriptor field roles are not named and are not promoted to semantic values or bounds.
